findings.description: Removing the `hasattr(fp, "read")` fallback makes the file-object check depend only on `isinstance(fp, _SupportsRead)`, which on newer Python versions uses static attribute lookup and misses readers whose `read` is provided dynamically via `__getattr__`.
findings.rationale: Trigger: a file-like proxy or wrapper that delegates `read` through `__getattr__` and is passed in `files`. Previously `hasattr` returned True and `fp.read()` was called. Now the runtime protocol check may return False, so the object falls through to the other branches and its content is not read as a file part. Impact: the upload silently sends wrong or missing file content instead of the file's data.
